about: Public-notice channels per operator or agency: pages, sites, feeds, lists and accounts through which the public is told of sewage discharges, by law, permit or voluntarily. Read by pipeline/ingest/notification_pages.py (schema and validator there; test tests/test_notice_channels.py).

fields.id: unique channel id: '<state lower>-' then lowercase letters, digits and hyphens; stable (record ids and snapshots follow the URL, not the id, but merges and reviews follow the id)
fields.state: two-letter postal code of the jurisdiction (DC included)
fields.operator_id: data/dischargers.json id of the operator, or null for an agency or group channel
fields.agency: the agency or group that runs the channel when it is not an operator in data/dischargers.json, else null
fields.name: public name of the operator or agency
fields.permit: the NPDES / state permit the channel serves (one of the operator's npdes_permits), or null
fields.urls: the URL(s) read, http(s); [] only for a channel that is not monitored (none found, email only)
fields.method: how the URLs are read (enums.method); null only when urls is []
fields.legal_basis: the law or permit clause that makes it a public channel, cited; null only for voluntary
fields.monitored: true when this module fetches it
fields.unmonitored_reason: when monitored is false: why (enums.unmonitored_reason); null when monitored
fields.publishes: what the research saw on it (enums.publishes): a current status, a rainfall likelihood, dated notices, documents, only a link elsewhere, sampling results, nothing
fields.note: research note, internal (not exported); required for none_found and other
fields.checked: date the row was last checked against the source, YYYY-MM-DD
fields.barrier: what keeps the channel's notices off the open web (enums.barrier), from unmonitored_reason, the kind and the note (barrier_for); null for a monitored row or one read through a feed (feed_ingested), and for a row the register does not settle (then barrier_review says why)

optional_fields.authority: who is credited on records from this channel (default: name)
optional_fields.noun: the noun of the health wording (default 'Notification page', 'Voluntary page' for voluntary rows)
optional_fields.link_text: for link_only / likelihood rows: what the page links to ('the shared rainfall site'); the wording is 'Links to <link_text> only'
optional_fields.status_pattern: regular expression that finds the current status on the page; when it stops matching the wording says so
optional_fields.entry: {start, end}: regular expressions that cut this row's entry out of a page several rows share (from the first line matching start to the next line matching end)
optional_fields.ignore_lines: regular expressions of volatile lines (readings, clocks) left out of the text hash
optional_fields.records: false: never make records from this channel (default true)
optional_fields.dated_lines_are_notices: true: any added dated line is a notice (an event table)
optional_fields.default_event_type: event type of a notice whose words name none (common.EVENT_TYPES)
optional_fields.every_hours: fetch at most this often (default: every refresh)
optional_fields.headers: 'browser' to send a browser user agent (hosts that refuse others)
optional_fields.feed_source_id: for feed_ingested: the source id of the feed that reads it
optional_fields.signup_url: where the public signs up for its alerts, when it has a list
optional_fields.seeds: {url: [{path, fetched_at, http_status}]}: earlier copies (research, surveys) taken as the first snapshots, oldest first; path relative to the project root
optional_fields.sources: research or registry ids the row rests on
optional_fields.barrier_review: internal: why an unmonitored row has no barrier yet (listed in docs/reviews/2026-11-03-barriers.md)

rules: channels sorted by (state, id); ids unique
operator_id or agency is given; operator_id exists in data/dischargers.json; a permit given with an operator_id is one of that operator's npdes_permits
monitored rows have urls and a method; unmonitored rows have an unmonitored_reason
basis_kind law or permit has a legal_basis
barrier is null for monitored and feed_ingested rows, follows login, bot_wall and image_only, and is set (or barrier_review given) for every other unmonitored row
regular expressions compile; seeds name the row's urls

channels.name: Aspetuck Health District
channels.note: Aspetuck Health District beach results. Voluntary local beach results. (research/ct/report.md §2.8)

channels.name: City of Bridgeport WPCA - East Side WPCF (Seaview Ave) and East Side combined sewers
channels.note: Bridgeport WPCA (East Side): own CSO notice practice. Voluntary: no Connecticut law requires an operator's own web notice (2026 HB 5522 would have; it died in the Senate). As West Side. (research/ct/report.md §2.7)

channels.name: City of Bridgeport WPCA - West Side WPCF (Bostwick Ave) and West Side combined sewers
channels.note: Bridgeport WPCA (West Side): own CSO notice practice. Voluntary: no Connecticut law requires an operator's own web notice (2026 HB 5522 would have; it died in the Senate). City WPCA page shows a 'Notification:' heading with phone numbers only; operator under contract. (research/ct/report.md §2.7)

channels.name: Connecticut River Conservancy
channels.note: Connecticut River Conservancy, Is It Clean? (E. coli results). Voluntary volunteer and CRC lab results, weekly in season; 63+ CT sites. (research/ct/report.md §2.11)

channels.name: Connecticut CSO permittees
channels.note: No web form: Signs at CSO outfalls ("Wet Weather Sewage Discharge Outfall"). Basis not established in the research (the permit text, RCSA 22a-430-3, was not read); DEEP's 2026-07-07 release tells the public to look for physical CSO signs. No online record. Covers: ct-bridgeport-wpca-east, ct-bridgeport-wpca-west, ct-gnhwpca, ct-norwich-npu, ct-mdc-hartford. (research/ct/report.md §2.7)

channels.name: Connecticut DEEP
channels.legal_basis: CGS 22a-424a(c)(4): real-time public notification system
channels.note: DEEP Everbridge text and email spill alerts (announced pilot). Announced for fall 2026, sign-up by town; no sign-up page on 2026-11-01. Watch the SRTK page. Covers every operator in the state. (research/ct/report.md §2.6)

channels.name: Connecticut DEEP
channels.note: DEEP HazConnect public incident list (live spill log). Voluntary publication of CGS 22a-450 reports; behind a Cloudflare bot check. https://connecticut.hazconnect.com/listincidentpublic.aspx answered 403 to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/ct/report.md §2.5)

channels.name: Connecticut DEEP
channels.legal_basis: CGS 22a-424a(b) and (c)(1): DEEP posts each spill or bypass report on its website within 2 hours of receipt, with a current map
channels.note: DEEP Performance Dashboard (Bypass / CSO Live Map; QAlert reports in Zoho Analytics). 2026 CSO rows lack the outfall group and receiving water for every utility but Bridgeport East. Covers every operator in the state. (research/ct/report.md §2.1-2.2)

channels.name: Connecticut DEEP
channels.note: DEEP news releases (large spills, seasonal rain reminders). Voluntary: no statute requires a press release; DEEP issued one for the 2025 East Windsor break and the 2026-07-07 rain reminder. Sign-up status: confirmed (email) (docs/subscriptions.md). (research/ct/report.md §2.6, §2.12)

channels.name: Connecticut DEEP
channels.note: DEEP Emergency Response spill log, data.ct.gov ffju-s5c5. Voluntary publication: spills are reported to DEEP under CGS 22a-450; the monthly dataset is DEEP's practice. Covers every operator in the state. (research/ct/report.md §2.5)

channels.name: Connecticut DEEP
channels.legal_basis: CGS 22a-424a(c)(5): annual report by February 1
channels.note: DEEP Sewage Right to Know page and annual reports (xlsx, PDF). Covers every operator in the state. (research/ct/report.md §2.4)

channels.name: Connecticut DEEP
channels.note: State Swimming Water Quality Report (state park beaches). Voluntary state park beach status, in season only. (research/ct/report.md §2.8)

channels.name: Connecticut DEEP
channels.legal_basis: CGS 22a-424a(c)(4): real-time public notification system within 2 hours of DEEP's receipt (DEEP says the X account meets it)
channels.note: DEEP X account @CTSewageSpills ("CT Sewer Overflows"). Posted by hand; X cannot be read without its API. Covers every operator in the state. (research/ct/report.md §2.6)

channels.agency: Connecticut Department of Agriculture, Bureau of Aquaculture
channels.name: Connecticut Department of Agriculture, Bureau of Aquaculture
channels.note: DoAg recreational shellfish hotlines and closure maps. Closures after rainfall announced by town phone lines and PDF maps; no statute cited in the research. (research/ct/report.md §2.10)

channels.name: Connecticut Department of Public Health
channels.note: DPH Beach Advisory portal (beachadvisory.ct.gov) with alert sign-up. Voluntary: closures follow DPH/DEEP guidelines (2016), not a statute; a sewage bypass may close a beach before sampling. TLS certificate expired on 2026-11-01. https://beachadvisory.ct.gov/ answered tls to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/ct/report.md §2.8)

channels.name: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency (ECHO)
channels.note: EPA ECHO sewer overflow and bypass event records (NPDES eReporting). Voluntary publication by EPA: operators must report noncompliance to the permitting authority within 24 hours (40 CFR 122.41(l)(6)); EPA publishes the electronic reports. . Covers every operator in the state. (research/federal/report.md)

channels.name: Farmington River Watershed Association
channels.note: Farmington River Watershed Association bacteria results. Voluntary sampling; also shown on Is It Clean?. (research/ct/report.md §2.11)

channels.name: Greater New Haven Water Pollution Control Authority (East Shore WPAF)
channels.note: Greater New Haven WPCA: own CSO notice practice. Voluntary: no Connecticut law requires an operator's own web notice (2026 HB 5522 would have; it died in the Senate). gnhwpca.com: CSO documents and construction alerts only. (research/ct/report.md §2.7)

channels.name: Harbor Watch
channels.note: Harbor Watch (Earthplace) Fairfield County River Report. Voluntary; raw data in the Water Quality Portal, annual report. (research/ct/report.md §2.11)

channels.name: Interstate Environmental Commission
channels.note: Interstate Environmental Commission pathogen monitoring network. Voluntary; western Long Island Sound. https://www.iec-nynjct.org/node/384 answered connection to the project user agent on 2026-11-03. (research/ct/report.md §2.11)

channels.name: Ledge Light Health District
channels.note: Ledge Light Health District beach results. Voluntary local beach results; HTTP 522 on 2026-11-01. (research/ct/report.md §2.8)

channels.name: Connecticut local health departments (others)
channels.note: Other local health departments' beach closures (Fairfield, Greenwich, Milford, New Haven, Stamford). Voluntary; pages not found in search. (research/ct/report.md §2.8)

channels.name: Vermont town health officers
channels.note: No URL known (not searched): Town health officers (local swim water testing and the 12-hour report). Voluntary for the public: § 1295(c)(1) sends the report to the local health officer, but no public duty follows; the Health Department says to ask the town health officer. Covers every operator in the state. (research/nh-vt/report.md §2.1, §2.4)
